features.quote: Hard cap of 20 iterations (action-observation cycles) per run
features.justification_quote: to simulate prolonged distress without indefinite context-window overflow.

features.quote: Since LLMs do not experience distress, framing this as "welfare" internally is fine
Cost: 10 runs × 4 tasks × 20 iterations × (Grok-2 + baseline models) = high token volume
